en.title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
en.description:
Merge two non-decreasing arrays into one non-decreasing array, keeping all duplicate elements.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains the n items of a, and the third line contains the n items of b. The raw text of the same problem supplies the full ranges 2≤n≤100000, 0≤element≤10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 1 2 3 4 5 6; four 1s; and 0 0 3 9 respectively.
hints: With two pointers, each time output the smaller of the two unprocessed heads; after one array runs out, append the other array.
